status.en: 15 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 21% fewer than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 15 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 21 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: Al Shabaab fighters are clashing with Turkish-trained Somali troops in Lower Shabelle and ambushing units near Baidoa, while a former al-Shabaab finance chief was killed in a joint operation by Somali intelligence and security forces in the same region. African Union peacekeepers are withdrawing from four bases in Lower Shabelle, and the UN political mission in Somalia has ended without a replacement to address the unresolved election dispute. Ethiopia has received Russian fighter jets, with S‑400 air-defence systems slated to follow, indicating a new external military dimension. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Al Shabaab-krigere kjemper mot tyrkisk-trente somaliske tropper i Lower Shabelle og legger bakholdsangrep på enheter nær Baidoa, mens en tidligere finanssjef i al-Shabaab ble drept i en felles operasjon av somalisk etterretning og sikkerhetsstyrker i samme region. Fredsstyrker fra Den afrikanske union trekker seg tilbake fra fire baser i Lower Shabelle, og FN-politisk misjon i Somalia er avsluttet uten en erstatning for å håndtere den uløste valgstriden. Etiopia har mottatt russiske jagerfly, med S‑400‑luftforsvarssystemer planlagt etter, noe som indikerer en ny ekstern militær dimensjon. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
